Appearance

Stocky, robust build with a well-groomed beard and strong arms. Piercing eyes that size up materials — and customers — with equal scrutiny.

What We Know

Owner of The Dragon's Breath Forge in Highreach. Renowned for crafting rare and very rare magical weapons and armor. Expert in metallurgy and enchantments — the blacksmith the elite trust.

First Impressions

Proud and meticulous. Speaks with a lisp but carries himself with total confidence.

Interactions

  • Traded weapon materials with the party — upgraded their equipment
